verdict.rationale: Figma Make is an AI app builder, so auth scaffolding is a fair question for it. The evidence only says you can add a backend to store and manage data. Nothing in the pack mentions user sign-up, login, email auth or social providers. Backend data storage is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder
